scope.description: Qualify Marconi Technologies as a new Canadian company candidate and deeply map its tactical communications, beyond-line-of-sight connectivity, SATCOM and mission-data portfolio using durable public evidence.

source.title: Marconi tactical communications product ecosystem
source.locator: Mission, About, Orion, Archer, Hunter, SAMS, Crypto and contact sections
source.summary: Marconi describes its Montréal-headquartered identity, tactical communications mission, public contact routes and Orion, Archer, Hunter and development-stage SAMS and cryptographic product lines.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official corporate portfolio, launch and technical datasheets; PMO contract corroboration; current allied field-trial reporting
followUpQuestions: Confirm the exact registered Canadian legal entity before populating legalName; the website footer uses Marconi Inc. but no registry record was resolved in this run.
reviewWarnings: SAMS and cryptographic products are described as coming soon; only SAMS is included and is explicitly marked development-stage, while the insufficiently detailed crypto item is excluded.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Official product and launch sources establish company identity, headquarters, portfolio, contact paths and ownership transition.
Government reporting independently confirms the Orion contract, made-in-Canada production, contract value threshold and delivery horizon.
Current attributed trial reporting supplies operational evidence for Archer with Sweden's defence materiel authority.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Marconi Technologies is a standalone, Canadian-majority-owned and veteran-run Montréal defence prime formed from Ultra I&C's Tactical Communications division. Durable official evidence supports Orion tactical MANET radios, Archer troposcatter, Hunter tactical SATCOM and the development-stage SAMS sensor-and-cyber fusion platform. Government of Canada reporting independently corroborates a current made-in-Canada Orion contract exceeding C$10 million.
